notes:
Very distinctive surname ('Aachi'), so no collision risk; every result on every query resolved to the same man. Identity verified on five criteria across independent OFFICIAL Apollo properties that agree: (1) askapollo.com, Apollo's official appointment domain, result title literally 'Dr Mithin Aachi | Orthopedician in Hyderabad - Apollo Hospitals Secunderabad' - this is the single best line of evidence because it confirms name + specialty + the exact UNIT (Secunderabad) in one string; (2) apollohospitals.com, two separate official pages ('Dr. Mithin Aachi - Best Orthopedician in Hyderabad' and the region/Hyderabad doctor page); (3) apollo247.com official doctor/booking page 'Dr. Mithin Aachi | Orthopaedician, Secunderabad'. Note apollohospitals.com's several pages count as ONE official domain - the High band rests on apollohospitals.com plus the separate apollo247.com/askapollo.com Apollo digital properties, both of which independently state Secunderabad. Matches the input row on name + specialty (Orthopedics) + hospital + unit (Apollo Hospitals Secunderabad) + city. A JustDial listing independently places 'Dr. Mithin Aachi (Apollo Hospital)' at Gopalapuram-Secunderabad, near Keys High School, beside Sangeet Theatre - i.e. the Apollo Secunderabad campus (used as a venue signal only; no JustDial number taken, they are call-tracking proxies).

PHONE DELIBERATELY NOT RECORDED: a search summary offered 04069321004 as his contact number. Per the mandatory rule I re-searched that exact string in quotes - it came back on a whole spread of unrelated Apollo Hyderabad pages (Financial District orthopaedics, ENT, surgical gastro, CTVS, neurosurgery doctor pages), which proves it is Apollo's GENERIC Hyderabad appointment line templated across the site, not Dr Aachi's own line and not even Secunderabad-specific. The brief explicitly forbids recording a hospital's central booking line as the doctor's, so professional_phone is blank; the hospital-level fallback covers the switchboard route.

No email, LinkedIn, personal website, clinic website, ORCID, Google Scholar, ResearchGate or professional social account surfaced in either query - all left blank rather than guessed. Apollo publishes no per-doctor email.

For a human to resolve: (a) EXPERIENCE - Apollo-derived text says 16+ years (agreeing with the input row) but aggregator profiles claim 23 and 25 years, and the quoted degree dates are internally impossible (MBBS 2001 with a DNB in 2000), so all aggregator biography detail here should be treated as unreliable; (b) the second practice at 'Apollo Clinic Boduppal' and the procedure-volume figures came from aggregator/medical-tourism text, not from an Apollo page, so they are leads only; (c) the Computer Navigation fellowship is stated as Germany in one summary and UK in another. owns_clinic left false - no evidence of an owned clinic entity or personal practice website.
